connector.why: Opened: same Bereshit Rabbah 67:4, Micah 7:20, Zohar I 143a and Esav = הא שוא; Yaakov's guile as wisdom against the serpent. Used at [4.33].
Opened 57:1-2: same Zohar I 143a on Psalm 120 and the question whether 'אנכי עשו בכורך' was false; different answer. Used at [3.8].
Opened 15:1: about wasting seed and the category of its prohibition; shares only stray words with this os.

candidates.why: Same Tanchuma, same question; also has Yaakov judging himself an unwitting killer (for causing Esav's intent to murder). Used at [2.10].
This is the Zohar Rav Tzadok himself cites (I 143a), so it is a source, not a parallel; given as source notes at [3.4] and [3.22].
Same Tanchuma and question; answers through rectifying Adam's sin of bloodshed rather than through falsehood. Used at [2.9].

found.why: Yaakov's 'אנכי עשו בכורך' discussed as a case of לישנא דמשתמע לתרי אפי; takes the stricter view.
On the same Zohar: Yaakov meant 'אנכי המביא ועשו הוא בכורך' and the 'lying lip' is the serpent's level in Esav.
